to_change.author: James Ray
to_change.article: We're All Going to be Called Terrorists Eventually

note: The featured-authors pool is computed, not a list: authors with an avatar, at least one published article, and a name that is not an organisation placeholder. This script recomputes it with the same query the section uses, so it stays correct as authors are added — re-running it later is the maintenance path for newly featured authors. Two of the three moves take articles OUT of the News tab on /news, which is the intended consequence of the request.
